perform log transformation with psuedo count

Source: R/ngs_rnaseq.R
log_transform.Rd

perform log transformation with psuedo count

log_transform(df_mat, count = 1, base = 2)

Arguments

df_mat

data.frame or matrix

count

psuedo count, default is 1

base

base of the log transformation, default is 2

Value

a log transformed data.frame

Examples


log_transform(count_df)
